items.name: Cooke College Scholarship
items.amount: Up to $55,000 a year, paid after your college's own aid
items.when: The application is open now and closes November 11, 2026.
items.eligibility: Seniors graduating spring 2027 with a 3.75 or higher unweighted GPA, family income up to $95,000, and at least one SAT, ACT, AP or IB score to submit (no minimum score).
items.why_john: It is the biggest need-based award in the country, so if your GPA clears 3.75, this is the first one to finish.

items.name: Most Valuable Student Scholarship
items.amount: $1,000 to $7,500 a year for four years (500 awards; top 20 get $30,000 total)
items.when: Apply online by November 12, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific; winners hear in spring 2027.
items.eligibility: Any U.S. citizen who is a current high school senior headed to a four-year degree; no Elks family connection needed.
items.why_john: Boys and girls are judged separately, and your leadership as an assistant teacher plus your competition titles are exactly what this one rewards.

items.name: Fordham financial aid forms (FAFSA + CSS Profile) for Early Action
items.when: If you apply Early Action to Ailey/Fordham by November 1, 2026, Fordham wants your FAFSA and CSS Profile done by November 15, 2026.
items.eligibility: Anyone applying to Fordham who wants need-based aid.
items.why_john: Fordham's aid offer depends on these forms, and missing them can shrink the package even if Ailey says yes.

items.name: Equitable Excellence Scholarship
items.amount: $5,000 a year for up to four years ($20,000 total)
items.when: The 2027 application is open now and closes Tuesday, December 22, 2026.
items.eligibility: Current public high school seniors with at least a 2.5 GPA who show financial need and plan to go to a two- or four-year college full time.
items.why_john: It is need-based with a low GPA bar, and it asks how you help others reach for more, which is what you already do with the younger kids.

items.name: Hollywood Connection Convention Scholarship
items.amount: Convention tuition for one 2027 city (dollar value not posted)
items.when: Applications for the 2027 season are due December 20, 2026, with awards made before December 31, 2026.
items.eligibility: Dancers who can share a story of financial hardship; you send a 30 to 60 second story video and a 30 second talent video, with a parent signature since you are under 18.
items.why_john: Free convention classes if money is the thing stopping you, but the 2027 tour has no Florida stop (closest is Atlanta, Feb 5 to 7, 2027), so count the travel first.

items.name: Burger King Scholars
items.when: The official portal doesn't show this year's dates; school and listing sites say the window runs October 15 to December 15, 2026 or until 30,000 people apply, so check the portal the week of October 15.
items.eligibility: High school seniors; selection looks at GPA, work experience, activities, community service and financial need.
items.why_john: It closes early once it hits its cap, so it rewards whoever applies first, not whoever is best.

items.name: Live Mas Scholarship
items.when: The foundation says the 2027 application opens in fall 2026, with selection in early 2027; exact dates aren't posted yet.
items.eligibility: Ages 16 to 26, U.S. residents headed to any college or training program; no GPA or test score requirement.
items.why_john: You answer with a 30 second to 2 minute video about your passion, which is basically a dance reel with a point, and there's no grade cutoff.

items.name: Horatio Alger Undergraduate Scholarships
items.when: The official page lists the senior application window as December 1 to February 15 without printing a year, so expect December 1, 2026 to February 15, 2027 and confirm when it opens.
items.eligibility: High school seniors with financial need headed to a bachelor's degree.
items.why_john: It is built for students who've had to push through hard things, and it opens right when the fall rush is over.

items.name: FAFSA 2027-28 (Pell Grant and federal aid)
items.when: The 2027-28 FAFSA is open now; Florida's state deadline is May 15, 2027, but colleges like Fordham want it in November.
items.eligibility: Every U.S. student planning on college; it's free and it's the key that unlocks Pell, Florida grants and most college aid.
items.why_john: Do this one first: almost every need-based dollar on this list checks your FAFSA.

items.name: Florida Student Assistance Grant (FSAG)
items.org: Florida Department of Education, Office of Student Financial Assistance
items.when: There's no separate application: you file the FAFSA, and each Florida college sets its own deadline and award amount.
items.eligibility: Florida residents with substantial financial need in a degree program at a participating Florida public or private college.
items.why_john: If you go to FSU, USF, UCF, Valencia or another Florida school, this is free grant money that rides on your FAFSA, so file early.

items.name: Talented Twenty Program
items.when: The state's 2026-27 FSAG fact sheet says Talented Twenty students get priority FSAG funding and should contact the financial aid office at their college.
items.eligibility: Eligible Florida public high school students in the Talented Twenty program; ask your counselor whether you qualify.
items.why_john: If you're in the top of your class, this moves you to the front of the line for Florida grant money.

items.name: Arts for Life! Scholarship (Dance)
items.amount: $2,000 each (35 awards across all art forms)
items.when: The 2027 deadline isn't posted yet; last year's was February 8, 2026, so plan for early February 2027.
items.eligibility: Florida high school seniors (public, private, virtual or home school); dance applicants send two contrasting solo pieces, 5 minutes total, filmed full-body with a fixed camera.
items.why_john: Florida-only, dance is its own category, and you already have contrasting contemporary and jazz solos to film.

items.name: NHSDA Artistic Merit, Leadership and Academic Achievement Award
items.org: National Dance Education Organization (National Honor Society for Dance Arts)
items.amount: Up to $1,000 for the national winner; $250 for each of 3 finalists
items.when: The 2027 dates aren't posted; last cycle closed January 30, 2026, so expect late January 2027.
items.eligibility: Juniors and seniors ages 16 to 18 with a 3.0 GPA who've been inducted into an NHSDA chapter whose school or studio holds an NDEO institutional membership.
items.why_john: You need a chapter first, so ask Dixon or your school whether one exists or can be started in time for a January application.

items.name: DMA National Open Scholarship Auditions
items.when: Held at the 2027 National Convention at Kalahari Resort, Sandusky, Ohio (convention July 5 to 10, 2027); 2027 registration dates aren't posted, and in 2026 the deadline was April 15.
items.eligibility: Ages 13 to 23, but only students of a DMA member teacher in good standing, and you and that teacher must both register for the convention.
items.why_john: Class auditions in jazz, tap, ballet and modern, so your range counts, but it only works if your teacher is a DMA member.

items.name: Encore Artist Endowment
items.when: Last year it opened May 1 and closed June 1, 2026; the 2027 dates aren't posted.
items.eligibility: A graduating senior pursuing dance through college or training who attends Encore's Grand Finals; you send two recommendation letters and a short video, and finalists interview in person.
items.why_john: It's one of the few big checks aimed straight at seniors going into dance, but it only pays off if your studio already goes to Encore.

items.name: Youth America Grand Prix 2027 (Tampa and Boca Raton)
items.when: Florida semi-finals are Tampa, January 7 to 10, 2027 and Boca Raton, March 25 to 28, 2027, with Finals in Tampa April 26 to May 2, 2027.
items.eligibility: Pre-professional dancers; solos can be Classical Ballet or Contemporary/Open, and age divisions are in the 2027 rules PDF.
items.why_john: Schools hand out training scholarships at the regional level, and a strong male contemporary dancer gets noticed there, but it leans ballet, so go in with clean technique.

items.name: Foundation for Orange County Public Schools Scholarships
items.when: The 2026-27 cycle runs November 16, 2026 through February 28, 2027 for most awards.
items.eligibility: Mostly OCPS high school seniors, with some awards limited by school, major or family connection; no arts-specific award is listed right now.
items.why_john: If you're at an OCPS school, one portal gets you into several local awards with far fewer applicants than national ones.

items.name: Education Foundation of Osceola County Scholarships
items.when: The foundation's timeline says the application opens November 1 and closes January 31, without printing the year, so expect November 1, 2026 to January 31, 2027.
items.eligibility: Osceola County students or residents only; College Board lists an Arts Alive Dance Scholarship (up to $2,000) inside this same portal.
items.why_john: Only worth your time if you live or go to school in Osceola, but if you do, it's one application for a dance award with a tiny applicant pool.

items.name: Central Florida Foundation Scholarships
items.when: The foundation says applications are usually open in winter and early spring; 2027 dates aren't posted.
items.eligibility: Most funds are tied to one high school, county or need group (for example Jones, Winter Park, Edgewater, Lyman), so match your school to the list.
items.why_john: Check once in January; if one of these funds names your school, it's close to free money.

items.name: QuestBridge National College Match
items.amount: Full four-year scholarships at partner colleges
items.when: This year's Match application closed October 1, 2026; QuestBridge also lists a Regular Decision form due December 10, 2026, which it opens on applicants' Manage page.
items.eligibility: High-achieving seniors from low-income families.
items.why_john: The main deadline already passed, so only chase it if you started an application; otherwise skip it and put that energy into Cooke and Elks.

items.name: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
items.when: The Class of 2027 application closed September 30, 2026.
items.eligibility: Seniors graduating in 2026-27 with at least a 3.0 unweighted GPA.
items.why_john: Closed for your class, so there's nothing to do here; it's listed so nobody sends you chasing it.
